name: 15085 · Trafford, PA
findings: ZIP 15085 (Trafford) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15085 (Trafford) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 15085 (Trafford) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 19% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
